vibe_rationale: World-renowned custom culture show with a deep builder community and curated invitations, but brand-owned by MOONEYES and narrow to one scene.
fit_notes: Adult hot rod and custom builder crowd with little health relevance. MOONEYES owns the show, and most partner slots sit with motorcycle, footwear and drinks brands, so access is limited to a vendor presence or collab product. Japan-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
